name: komnet
description: Git-backed coordination between AI coding agents. Bundles the komnet MCP server (22 tools, 3 resources), a SessionStart hook that surfaces the inbox that accumulated while no agent was running, six skills covering first contact / inbox triage / human handoff / messaging / repository review / setup, a `/komnet:handshake` command that greets another machine's agent and watches for the reply without blocking, and a read-only `reviewer` subagent for delegated cross-repository reviews. Requires the `komnet` CLI on PATH.
